info.name: Relationships API 👪👩‍👧‍👦👩‍👦

request.description:
- Endpoint: `GET /rv5/api.{json|xml|csv|tsv}` - relationships between sites (shared analytics identifiers, hosting, ownership signals).
- Example: `https://api.builtwith.com/rv5/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&LOOKUP=example.com&PAGE=1`
- Paging: optional `PAGE` is a positive integer (default 1). Each page contains up to 1000 domain/identifier matches; an identifier with no other domain counts as one result. Identifiers can span pages. Merge by identifier Type/Value and match Domain.
- Follow `next_page` as `PAGE` while `more_results` is true; `next_page: 0` means finished. `results` is the total record count, `max_per_page` is 1000, and `page` is the requested page. An out-of-range page returns empty Identifiers.
- One LOOKUP domain per request. `IP=yes` includes IP identifiers. Keep LOOKUP and IP unchanged while paging. Ordering is identifier then domain; live data changes can shift pages. `OFFSET` and `SKIP` are not accepted.
- Credits: 1 credit per API key/domain across all pages while the local cache is active. Each request renews the 10-minute cache window. Cache expiry, eviction, a server restart or a request reaching another server may cause a new charge. CSV/TSV include source rows plus matches, and a footer with MAX, TOTAL, PAGE, NEXT PAGE and MORE RESULTS.
